goal: Make agent-to-reviewer handoffs fail fast before a reviewer draw is consumed (#2998), and front-load the probe checklist and terminal verdict line into the reviewer brief (#2923), without reducing any review requirement.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator issues in this repository
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, function, view, role, grant, index, or timeout change.
Do not reduce what a reviewer must check, make any verdict optional, or let a failed handoff read as an approval.
No --admin override on this code change.
assumptions: Issue #2915 was verified already delivered on main by commits cdc74cb5 and 3cef6b68 and was closed with revert evidence rather than reimplemented.
GitHub computes pull request mergeable asynchronously, so a null value must proceed rather than refuse; the guarded merge lane still refuses a real conflict.
PR #3316 also edits manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs for #2457/#2844; its hunks are at lines 1272, 2395, 4258-4366 and 5518-5776 and do not overlap the sites changed here.
stop_conditions: Stop if any change would reduce what a reviewer must check or make a verdict optional.
Stop if a fail-fast refusal could be mistaken for an approval.
Stop if reviewer allocation is refused repo-wide by the known cursor-parser blocker rather than by this change.
